summary.text: Alex Falconer is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 49A, in office since January 2025, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Jeff Houdek.

paragraphs.text: Alex Falconer graduated from Red Wing High School and earned a bachelor's degree in biology from St. Olaf College.
Ballotpedia says his career includes work as campaign manager for Save the Boundary Waters.
Falconer defeated Stacy Bettison in the November 5, 2024, general election for District 49A and assumed office on January 14, 2025.
He serves on the Commerce Finance and Policy, Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy, and Education Policy committees.
